callouts.text: 1 · Ten cards, top to bottom. Same Blocks and same cables every time — only the boundary port, the routing and the marks change.
2 · Drag any Block. Each card's dotted back cable is a real connection carrying temporal: delayed, so it reflows and keeps its z⁻¹ pill.
3 · The body is merge() then smooth() because the editor refuses a cable from a Block to itself — a one-Block accumulator has no real back cable yet.
PASS WHEN one card reads correctly without the caption: which value is the collection, which is the element, and which arrives next turn.
